title: Inner Sound — the earth plays music through its bones

concept.what: P-waves are compression waves. Literally sound through rock. Every earthquake is a note played on the planet's body. Magnitude is volume. Depth is pitch. Longitude is pan. The earth IS an instrument.

mapping.magnitude_to_velocity: M2.5 = pp (pianissimo). M4.0 = mf (mezzo-forte). M5.0 = f (forte). M6.0 = ff. M7.0+ = fff (fortissimo).
mapping.depth_to_pitch: 0-30 km (shallow) = HIGH (cymbal, C5-C6). 30-100 km = MID (horn, C3-C4). 100-300 km = LOW (bass, C1-C2). 300+ km = SUB (felt not heard, below C1).
mapping.longitude_to_pan: lon / 180 = stereo position. -1.0 = hard left (Pacific). 0.0 = Greenwich. +1.0 = hard right (dateline).
mapping.latitude_to_reverb: equator = dry. poles = cathedral reverb. 45° = room.
mapping.gap_to_clarity: USGS 'gap' field = azimuthal gap in station coverage. Small gap = clear note. Large gap = fuzzy, uncertain.

concept.pi_sense: pi-hearing — the deepest listening. Below weather, below river, below solar wind. The inner sound.

score.title: October 23, 2026 — 36 notes
score.tempo: irregular — quakes don't keep time. The rhythm IS the message.
score.key: no fixed key — each quake plays its own frequency based on depth

movements.name: Italy Cluster (the crash)
movements.character: 5 cymbal crashes from the same spot (14°E, 38°N). All shallow (10 km). Tight. Loud. Aftershocks from M5.7 lead.
movements.sound: a porcelain plate dropped on tile — sharp, ringing, repeated

movements.name: China Aftershocks (the echo)
movements.character: Nagqu M7.0 aftershock swarm. All shallow (10 km). Yesterday's giant still ringing.
movements.sound: a bell struck yesterday, still vibrating — each ring quieter than the last

movements.name: South America Bass (the drone)
movements.character: Chile 142 km, Bolivia 236 km, Argentina 186 km. All deep. All from the Nazca subduction zone. The plate sliding under the continent.
movements.sound: tectonic bass — a ship's hull groaning in deep water

movements.name: Pacific Sub-bass (the rumble)
movements.character: Philippines 591 km, Fiji 572 km, Tonga 463 km. The deepest notes. Below hearing. Felt in the chest.
movements.sound: infrasound — you don't hear it, you FEEL your organs vibrate

movements.name: Pacific Rim Scatter (the texture)
movements.character: Japan M5.1 (horn), Russia M4.8 (horn), PNG M5.0 (cymbal), Indonesia, Pakistan. The Ring of Fire shimmering.
movements.sound: gamelan — scattered bells across a wide stage

movements.name: Alaska-West Coast (the baseline)
movements.character: Alaska M4.0-4.2, California M3.0-3.4, Hawaii M2.7-3.3, Panama M4.0. The Americas' quiet hum.
movements.sound: distant thunder — always there, usually ignored

today_voice.summary: Italy is the lead — 5 crashes from the Tyrrhenian Sea. China echoes yesterday's M7.0. South America drones bass from the Nazca plate. The deep Pacific rumbles below hearing. The Ring of Fire shimmers gamelan-style across the right channel. Alaska and California murmur from the left.

sonification_params.description: Parameters for weather-song.js or any audio engine to render the inner sound.
sonification_params.freq_formula: freq = 1047 * exp(-depth_km / 120). Shallow (0km) = 1047 Hz (C6). 120 km = 385 Hz (G4). 600 km = 7 Hz (sub). Exponential decay — the deeper, the lower.

fold_connection.integration: Inner sound IS the bass line for weather-song. Solar = melody (Kp drives tempo, X-ray drives key). Weather = harmony (pressure, humidity, wind). Earthquakes = bass + percussion (depth is pitch, magnitude is volume). River = rhythm section (discharge rate = tempo). Together: the planetary symphony.

source: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program — public domain, no auth required
